scope: Twelve retained developer-authored cases, two executions each; 24 initial calls plus at most one contradiction recheck per candidate, maximum 48 calls. Not independent held-out or full A1/A2 validation.
stop_rule: Complete the fixed 24-case schedule; at most one recheck only for a detected exact-source-existence contradiction. No transport retries, tuning, or replacement of initial evidence.
review_basis: Expected statuses fixed from declared Observation boundaries before any model call; labels and case ids are never passed to the model.
